title: FlexLine Repayment Term and Late-Fee History
content:
FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit — when a line is closed to new draws while a balance remains, months are taken off the term over which the balance is repaid according to the late-fee entries on the line in the last 12 months.

| Late-fee entries on the line in the last 12 months | Months taken off the term |
|---|---|
| two or more | 6 |
| exactly one | 3 |
| none | 0 |

The cut never takes the term below 12 months: months are taken off only after any months are added to the term, and a cut that would leave fewer than 12 months leaves 12.

The last 12 months are the entries dated after the same day of the month 12 months before the closing date. Every late-fee entry on the line dated in that window counts, whatever its amount.

*Hypothetical cases.* For a closing on 10 October, a late-fee entry dated 11 October of the year before counts and one dated 10 October of the year before does not. A line with late-fee entries dated in February and in July of the closing year has two and loses 6 months; a line with only the July entry loses 3. A term standing at 14 months that loses 6 stands at 12.
